spans.s:
f. (-का)
A cricket.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Attached or attentive to, devoted to, engrossed by.
2 Served, worshipped.
3 Dressed, cooked.
n. (-क्तं)
1 Boiled rice.
2

Food.
3

Any edible grain boiled with water.
m. (-क्तः)
A follower, a votary.
E.
भज to serve, &c. aff. क्त.

m. (-क्तः)
1 A follower, a dependant, one to whom food is regularly given.
2 Grain, edible grain, as rice, &c.
E.
भक्त food, aff. अण्.

m. (-रः)
Factitious incense, incense prepared from various fragrant resins and perfumes.
E.
भक्त dressed, and कर making.

m. (-रः)
A cook.
E.
भक्त boiled rice, and कार who makes.

n. (-न्दं)
Appetite, wish for food.
E.
भक्त, and छन्द will.

f. (-जा)
Nectar.

f. (-ता)
Devotedness, implied faith in and attachment to.
E.
भक्त, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, भक्तत्वं.

n. (-र्य्यं)
Music played at the hour of eating, amongst princes and great men.
E.
भक्त rice or food, and तूर्य्य a musical instrument.

m. (-दः)
A supporter, a maintainer.
E.
भक्त, and द who gives; also भक्तदायक, भक्तदायिन्, &c.

m. (-ता)
A maintainer, a feeder.
E.
भक्त food, and दातृ donor.

m. (-सः)
A slave, one maintained in consideration of service.
E.
भक्त food, दास a slave.

f. (-क्तिः)
1 Service, worship.
2 Faith, belief.
3 Devotion or attachment to.
4 Part, portion.
5 Fracture, division.
6 Metonymy.
E.
भज to serve, or भञ्ज to break, aff. क्तिन्.

mfn. (-भान्-मती-मत्)
Faithful, devoted to.
E.
भक्ति, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-गः)
Devotion or worship, as shewn by implicit faith in any divinity.
E.
भक्ति, and योग devotion.

m. (-लः)
1 A good horse.
2 A follower, a votary.
E.
भक्ति service, &c. ला to afford, aff. ड.

r. 1st and 10th cls. (भक्षति भक्षयति)
To eat.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Gluttonous, voracious, gourmand.
2 A feeder, an eater, who or what eats.
f. (-क्षिका)
A meal, a feed.
E.
भक्ष to eat, aff. ण्वुल्.

m. (-रः)
A confectioner, a pastry cook.
E.
भक्ष food, and कार who prepares; also भक्षङ्कार.

n. (-णं)
Eating.
E.
भक्ष to eat, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Eatable, to be eaten.
E.
भक्ष, and अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Eating.
E.
भक्ष to eat, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Eating.
E.
भक्ष to eat, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Eaten.
E.
भक्ष to eat, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be eaten, what may be eaten
E.
भक्ष to eat, तव्य aff.; also भक्षयितव्य.

mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं)
Eatable. n (-क्ष्यं) Food.
E.
भक्ष to eat, aff. यत्.

m. (-रः)
A baker.
E.
भक्ष्य eatable, and कार who makes or prepares; also भक्ष्यंकार.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
To be eaten.
E.
भक्ष to eat, pass. v., शानच् aff.

m. (-टः)
1 A mountain, apparently the part of the Himālaya, called

Bhākūr.
2

A sort of fish.
E.
भा light, कूट peak or quantity.

m. (-षः)
The sun.
E.
भा light, कोष receptacle.

m. (-कः)
One who is fed by another, a dependant, a retainer.
E.
भक्त food, aff. ठक्.
